answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts split across independent auditors. Reaching the island of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a concise reports, one example per claim register, it stays short. The lagoon holds work receipts rather than names, so the ridge of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
